NONE: › a flat piece of wood or metal at the back of a boat or aircraft, moved from side to side in order to control the direction of travel
› (of an organization) without anyone in control and therefore unable to take decisions
（組織）群龍無首的，無人領導的，無人管理的
› used to avoid saying bloody to express anger
（用於代替 bloody，表示氣憤或惱怒）可惡的，討厭的，該死的

example: He was ruddy-cheeked from the walk in the cold.
大冷天他在外面走，臉凍得紅紅的。
Her face was ruddy and healthy-looking.
她臉色紅潤，看上去很健康。
Ruddy hell!
「該死的！」

NONE: B1 not polite; offensive or embarrassing
不禮貌的；粗魯的，粗野的；討厭的
B2 relating to sex or going to the toilet

before noun: 突如其來的；突兀的；令人不知所措的；猛烈的

NONE: › old use or literary simply and roughly made

example: He's a very rude man.
他這人很粗魯。
It's rude not to say "Thank you" when you are given something.
別人給你東西，你不說「謝謝」是不禮貌的。
He's got no manners - he's rude to everyone.
他這人很無禮——他對誰都很粗魯。
He told a rude joke/story.
他講了個下流的笑話／故事。
We had a rude awakening (= unpleasant shock) when we saw our phone bill.
看到我們的電話話費單時我們好像當頭挨了一棒。
We built a rude shelter from rocks on the beach.
我們用石塊在海灘上壘了一個簡易棚。

NONE: › Rudimentary methods, equipment, systems, or body parts are simple and not very well developed.
原始的；簡陋的；未充分發展的

example: Her knowledge is still only rudimentary.
她仍然只是粗通皮毛。
Some unusual fish have rudimentary legs.
有些罕見的魚類長有未發育完全的腿。
